query_ground_truth.workflow_task: As a project manager reorganizing our team's workflow, I need to set up a new project tracking column in our main Trello board for the upcoming sprint. Additionally, a key stakeholder asked for an update on a specific discussion in our team Slack channel, so I need to find that exact message and drop a thumbs-up emoji reaction on it to acknowledge their point before our daily standup meeting.
query_ground_truth.query: add a thumbs up emoji reaction to the stakeholder's update message in the team Slack channel
query_ground_truth.rationale: Applies the emoji reaction to the specific message identified by its timestamp in Slack.

request.query: add a thumbs up emoji reaction to the stakeholder's update message in the team Slack channel

results.use_case: add a thumbs up emoji reaction to the stakeholder's update message in the team Slack channel
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if write identity/scopes are uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm active token context using SLACK_TEST_AUTH (fail fast before any write).

[Optional (if the target conversation or timestamp is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Locate the exact message using SLACK_SEARCH_MESSAGES (confirm the correct conversation and message timestamp before writing).
[Required (for write safety)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch current reactions using SLACK_FETCH_ITEM_REACTIONS (confirm the item exists and avoid duplicate reactions).
[Required] [Step]: Add the reaction using SLACK_ADD_REACTION_TO_AN_ITEM (apply the emoji to the verified message).

[Fallback (if add fails due to auth/toolkit context or an error field such as missing_scope)] [Fallback]: Retry the add using SLACKBOT_ADD_REACTION_TO_AN_ITEM (alternate credential context; treat any returned error as authoritative).
[Optional (if an undo is needed)] [Next Step]: Remove the reaction using SLACK_REMOVE_REACTION_FROM_ITEM (revert the same message + emoji).
known_pitfalls: [SLACK_ADD_REACTION_TO_AN_ITEM] Requires an emoji short name; sending a rendered glyph can fail or apply an unintended reaction.
[SLACK_ADD_REACTION_TO_AN_ITEM] Targets an exact message timestamp; mismatches can react to the wrong item (e.g., parent vs reply).
[SLACKBOT_ADD_REACTION_TO_AN_ITEM] Can surface missing_scope (or similar) in the response even when transport looks successful; always check the error field.
[SLACK_SEARCH_MESSAGES] Can return multiple close matches; confirm both conversation identifier and message timestamp before writing.
[SLACK_ADD_REACTION_TO_AN_ITEM] May fail if the toolkit isn’t connected/authorized; use SLACKBOT_ADD_REACTION_TO_AN_ITEM as the fallback context.

SLACK_ADD_REACTION_TO_AN_ITEM.description: Adds a specified emoji reaction to an existing message in a Slack channel, identified by its timestamp; does not remove or retrieve reactions.

name.description: Name of the emoji to add as a reaction (e.g., 'thumbsup'). This is the emoji name without colons. For emojis with skin tone modifiers, append '::skin-tone-X' where X is a number from 2 to 6 (e.g., 'wave::skin-tone-3'). The emoji must already exist in the workspace; custom or non-existent emoji names will fail silently.

channel.description: ID of the channel where the message to add the reaction to was posted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to which the reaction will be added. This is a unique identifier for the message, typically a string representing a float value like '1234567890.123456'. Must be the exact message timestamp; permalinks or approximate values will not work.

SLACK_FETCH_ITEM_REACTIONS.description: Fetches reactions for a Slack message, file, or file comment. Exactly one identifier path must be provided: `channel`+`timestamp`, `file`, or `file_comment`. Mixing identifiers (e.g., providing both `channel`+`timestamp` and `file`) causes errors. If the response omits the `reactions` field, the item has zero reactions.

file.description: File ID. Use instead of channel/timestamp or file comment ID.

full.description: If true, returns the complete list of users for each reaction.

channel.description: Channel ID. Required if `timestamp` is provided and no file or file comment ID is given.

timestamp.description: Message timestamp (e.g., '1234567890.123456'). Required if `channel` is provided and no file or file comment ID is given. Thread reply timestamps are tracked separately from the parent message; use the reply's own timestamp to fetch its reactions.

file_comment.description: File comment ID. Use instead of channel/timestamp or file ID.

SLACK_REMOVE_REACTION_FROM_ITEM.description: Removes an emoji reaction from a message, file, or file comment in Slack. Provide exactly one targeting method: channel+timestamp together, file, or file_comment. Mixing methods or omitting all returns invalid_arguments.

file.description: ID of the file to remove the reaction from.

name.description: Name of the emoji reaction to remove (e.g., 'thumbsup'), without colons. Must be Slack's canonical emoji name; non-canonical names return a 'no_reaction' error.

channel.description: Channel ID of the message. Required if `timestamp` is provided.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message. Required if `channel` is provided.

file_comment.description: ID of the file comment to remove the reaction from.
